title: 12-apps: Python SOS rejects (4.01) instead of silently dropping unsigned/invalid SOS (18.4.1)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.4.1: unsigned or invalid SOS messages are silently dropped. C drops silently (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/sos_origin.h:19, no relay). Python returns 4.01 (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:237-238,248-251) — a rejection, which permits sender enumeration that the spec's silent drop is meant to prevent. Decide which layer owns the silent-drop semantic and align Python. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-029.
